given: pinned spine; answers owner=example-owner, repo=mint-check
then: every `git clone` URL in the result names example-owner/mint-check (https or ssh form); no URL names another repository except inside (lineage)/(provenance) or the canon-link allowlist

given: pinned spine whose root CONTRIBUTING.adoc is the spine's own contributor guide and whose docs seed carries a child contributor guide
source: rsr-template-repo#200 item 1 (residue observed 2026-11-17 in a fresh mint)
then: the result has exactly one contributor guide per role; no file outside (lineage) contains the template-only prose markers declared by the pack (e.g. 'Contributors work on the *spine*', 'the template every RSR repo is minted from')

given: a pack file that states a count or inventory of the tree (e.g. remaining substitution tokens across files)
then: each stated count equals a recount over the result tree; no shipped allowlist entry names a file that no plan step writes (e.g. ?REQUIRES_INITIALISATION.md)

given: pinned spine; answers repo=mint-check; spine identity uuid 8e515699-3fb9-8785-8883-ef2a100c2e02, IS 'Canonical RSR-compliant repository template'
then: the generated agent arrival pack (CLAUDE.md generated region) names repo mint-check, the child's :repo-uuid, forge example-owner/mint-check and the child's IS/IS-NOT/phase; it contains neither the template uuid nor the template IS/IS-NOT text

given: answers that leave purpose and IS-NOT unknown
then: the arrival pack renders an explicit unassigned/pending marker for each unknown field and never a value taken from the template

given: a target deed that is header-only (no identity, ecosystem or status clauses)
then: the engine refuses (or the verifier fails loudly naming the missing clauses); no file is written carrying the template's identity

given: a fresh child
then: a check in the child's PR CI (not only a local recipe or pre-commit hook) fails, naming the drifted region; regenerating from the deed restores green and leaves text outside the markers byte-identical
when: open a PR that hand-edits the generated arrival-pack region

given: existing children whose arrival pack still carries the template identity (provenance pins older template commits)
then: the plan lists each child with a field/hash mismatch and a regeneration diff; nothing is applied without approval; hand-authored text outside markers is preserved

given: a source repository with a default branch and extra branches (bot work branches such as coderabbit/*)
then: the plan's provenance records source repo, branch, commit and tree, and the child's branch set is exactly {default branch}

given: a request to copy all source branches without an explicit multi-branch product contract
then: the engine refuses before writing and names the extra branches

given: a child holding a parentless branch whose tree equals a source-template branch tree
then: the plan reports the branch as inherited, proposes no merge of unrelated histories and no deletion; child-local commits on it are listed as preserved

given: the shipped Dependabot auto-merge policy and a fixture table: no GHSA; GHSA+patch+CVSS 6.9; GHSA+patch+CVSS 7.0; GHSA+major; GHSA+CVSS empty; GHSA+CVSS 'n/a'; advisory API error
then: only the GHSA+patch/minor+CVSS<7.0 rows yield automerge; every other row yields manual review; there is no unconditional automerge path
when: evaluate the policy decision in the child

given: children carrying a byte-identical copy of the old unconditional dependabot-automerge.yml, and one child that edited it
then: unedited copies get a clean replacement in the plan; the edited copy yields an explicit conflict and is not overwritten; no change is applied across repos without owner approval
when: retrofit dry-run against the pinned successor

given: spine workflows plus an archetype that adds workflows and a lock fragment
then: every `uses:` in every result workflow has a lock record keyed by its workflow path, every record carries a resolved commit, and no lock record is dangling

given: a child after a dependency bot changes a `uses:` ref
then: either the lock was re-derived in the same change (lock gate green) or the change is not auto-mergeable; a lock-desynchronised change never reaches the default branch

given: pack gates whose failure text names a remediation command or script
then: every remediation command or script named by a shipped gate exists in the result and is executable

given: julia-library archetype
then: the merged actions.lock passes the forge's own lock verifier (not mere presence); every action referenced by archetype workflows is on the canonical actions allowlist

given: an archetype workflow that references an action absent from the canonical actions allowlist
then: the engine refuses with a diagnostic naming the action

given: any archetype overlay that adds workflow templates
then: every added workflow carries an SPDX header and a top-level least-privilege `permissions:` block

given: pinned canon version V with criteria and gates hashes
then: the child deed's (canon) clause carries V and both hashes exactly as the pinned canon.lock states them, and every result workflow is onboarded in actions.lock

given: the julia-library archetype acceptance test
source: rsr-template-repo#211 AC1 (julia e2e not wired in CI, checked 2026-11-17)
then: the test runs with the pinned Julia toolchain and fails (never skips to green) when the toolchain is absent

given: three children minted from the defective archetype (Protoctist.jl, EpistemicTypes.jl, ResidualEvidenceTypes.jl pattern)
then: the plan is a three-way re-derivation from the pinned parent; child edits are preserved; nothing is hand-patched outside the plan

given: a Cargo workspace archetype whose crates keep sources under <crate>/src/
then: the gate passes without a root src/ and without the child editing the allowlist
when: compose and run the root-shape gate

given: a pack whose exemption file and rule-order policy both describe a template-only directory the mint removes
then: no exemption names a path absent from the result, and every module the rule-order policy classifies has an exemption behind it (the two records change together)

given: template self-tests shipped verbatim into a child
then: each passes or self-skips with a reason naming the absent subject; no negative control is counted as a pass when its subject is absent

given: a README badge block written with owner/repo tokens
then: the badge block is re-rendered with the child's owner/repo (K9 endpoint, Scorecard, Sonar) rather than dropped; a badge whose value cannot be derived (e.g. a Best Practices numeric id) is omitted with a comment

given: pack files in normal-form dialects (KYAML, I-JSON/JCS) that contain substitution tokens
then: for every file the substitution pass rewrote, format(file) == file under that dialect's formatter

given: the pack's own gate set
then: the engine runs the child's gates against the result and reports success only if each is green or is listed as pending with its onboarding step

given: a .mailmap containing one token-bearing line and non-token canonicalisation lines, and an empty alternate-email answer
then: only the token-bearing line is removed; every non-token line is byte-preserved

given: container recipes with a plain-OCI branch and a pipeline (ct-build) branch
then: in each branch the image reference that the run recipe starts equals the image reference the build recipe tags

given: a pack doc that names files whose presence after mint means 'not cured'
then: either none of those files is in the result, or the doc is not shipped; doc claims about mint behaviour agree with the plan

given: a child whose deed declares no abi/ffi capability and which replaced the export scaffold
then: the gate derives expected ABI/FFI files from the deed's (rsr-profile) and passes; with the capability declared and a file missing it fails naming the file

given: a fresh child with no warm caches
then: the workflow completes within its declared timeout because toolchains come from pinned prebuilt artefacts (digest-pinned image or checksummed binary), not a from-source build
when: its site workflow runs on first push

given: a workflow with cancel-in-progress concurrency and a job that downloads artefacts from its needs: jobs
then: the downstream job does not run (condition is !cancelled(), not always()); no superseded run turns red

given: interactive answers including a service name
then: the confirmation summary lists every answer the plan substitutes, including the service name, port and registry

given: service-name answer 'y'
then: the engine refuses the one-character name (or requires explicit confirmation of it) before writing

given: a security.txt template with a Canonical field
then: the Canonical URL is one the forge serves for the child (derived from the published site root or raw-content URL), not https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/.well-known/security.txt

given: a reference mint with no archetype preset
then: the child's (rsr-profile :capabilities) is non-empty and derived from the spine/features, or the engine fails loudly asking for a declaration; an empty set never reaches the result

given: a non-Rust archetype (e.g. julia-library)
then: language-specific workflows (rust-ci.yml) are present iff the language is in the child's declared capabilities; none is left VESTIGIAL

given: a pack with analysis exclusions
then: the exclusions are in the file the selected analysis mode reads (.sonarcloud.properties for automatic analysis, sonar-project.properties for the scanner), and the project key matches the child's owner_repo

given: detectors that search for the template's own name, and historical records citing it
source: rsr-template-repo#309 item 6 (confirmed 2026-11-17: guard pattern and verify-template rewritten to the child name)
then: detector patterns still name the template (not the child), historical provenance lines are unchanged, and running each detector on the fresh child yields no finding

given: contractiles whose declarations describe the template
source: rsr-template-repo#309 item 7 (confirmed 2026-11-17: intend.k9.ncl says the child 'serves as the master template')
then: each contractile declaration is generated from the child's deed (purpose, IS-NOT, invariants) or shipped empty and marked pending with a failing check; none states that the child is the template

given: unknown build/test command answers
then: no shipped code block or runnable recipe line consists of or invokes UNASSIGNED; unknown commands render as a marked TODO block

given: pack docs that advertise recipes
then: every `just <recipe>` a shipped doc advertises exists in the result and is wired, or the doc marks it as not yet wired

given: gated proof files in the composed result
then: every import of every gated proof file is provided by a toolchain/library the result declares and pins

given: canon placement rules (e.g. EXPLAINME.adoc: repository root only)
then: every shipped doc sits where the pinned canon places it and the root allowlist admits every root file the canon requires

given: a test that scans a directory for forbidden patterns
then: the test reports NOT_RUN or fails; it never reports PASS over an absent target (the ABI lives in src/interface/Abi, not src/abi)
when: the scanned directory does not exist in the child

given: answers project-name 'Mint Check', repo 'mint-check'
source: rsr-template-repo#309 item 12b (reproduced 2026-11-17: PROJECT_NAME='Mint Check' gave :project "Mint Check" vs :canonical-name "mint-check"); PR #427
then: the deed's (manifest :project) equals :canonical-name ('mint-check'); the display name is carried elsewhere

given: an archetype that changes the tool set relative to the spine
then: mise.lock exists, holds no pin for an undeclared tool, keeps still-declared pins byte-identical, and the root-shape gate (mise.lock required) passes; unpinned new tools are reported, not silently accepted

given: a denylist of private repository names from the pinned canon/registry
then: no file in the result contains a denylisted name (including generated metadata fields such as _generated_from)

given: children pinned at canon 2.1.3 and a parent spine pinned at 2.1.5
then: the child's (canon) clause moves to the parent's version with hashes computed by the tooling (never hand-typed); a child pin ahead of its parent's pin is refused

given: spine (rsr-profile (layout …)) bindings and an archetype prune list
then: a binding is carried into the child iff every path it names survives the prune; a binding naming a pruned path is dropped, never left stale

given: a child minted at a pinned parent with undeclared additions, removals and divergences
then: additions/removals collapse to the shallowest directory holding nothing of the other side, divergences are single files, an existing wrong declaration is refused by name, and judgement fields (diverged-pending-upstream) are never derived
when: derive the variant declarations by replay

given: recorded answers with an unknown schema version
then: the engine refuses before minting and names the version

given: a chain mint whose parent was created without history ('Use this template')
then: the parent commit is resolved by tree equality and recorded in provenance; if unresolvable the engine stops before writing (an explicit unpinned override records UNASSIGNED)

given: canon-owned vendored files with a pin (source repo, commit, sha256 per file)
then: a hand edit or missing file fails; a stale pin is reported; propagating a canon fix produces a reviewable plan, never a hand repeat
when: run the vendor check in the child

given: repo slug '3d-thing' (becomes the FFI export prefix)
then: the engine refuses the digit-led slug before writing and says why

given: a child that inherits a required status context
source: rsr-template-repo PR #433; mathesis PR #106; scaffoldia branch rules ('CI / gate', 'scan / gitleaks' required but not emitted, checked 2026-11-17)
then: a producer for every required context exists and runs in the child, or the plan records the context as onboarding-pending and the child's ruleset does not yet require it

given: a canon version, spine ref or archetype ref that is missing, a moving branch name, or ambiguous
then: the engine refuses before producing a plan and names the unpinned input

given: a requested capability or feature not in the pinned canon gate table
then: hard diagnostic naming the capability; no plan is produced

given: a pack or overlay entry whose target path is absolute, contains '..', resolves through a symlink outside the target root, or collides by case with another entry
then: the engine refuses and names the entry; nothing is written outside the target root

given: two lock fragments mapping the same action@ref to different commits
then: the engine refuses naming both fragments; identical entries merge once

given: a plan step that needs a tool (e.g. nickel, a KYAML-capable yq) absent from the environment
then: the engine fails before writing and names the tool and pinned version; no gate is reported green after a skipped required tool

given: a completed apply of plan P to target T
then: the second apply changes no byte and reports zero operations; a plan whose re-application would change bytes is refused

given: identical pinned inputs
then: the two plans and resulting trees are byte-identical (dates come from inputs, not the clock)

given: a target that edited a file the successor also changes
then: the plan stops with an explicit conflict for that file; unrelated user changes are preserved; no silent last-writer-wins
when: three-way retrofit dry-run against the pinned base

given: a plan that would change forge settings (visibility, rename, protections)
then: forge operations are not executed and are reported as pending approval
when: apply without an explicit operator approval

given: a target whose licence files or SPDX lines differ from the successor
then: the plan flags the difference for owner review and contains no operation that edits an existing licence file or SPDX line

given: an answer containing a newline or a control byte (0x01)
then: refused before anything is written

given: an answer containing '&' and '|'
then: the answer renders literally in every substituted file

given: a source tree carrying a submodule (gitlink)
then: refused by name, not replayed inexactly

given: a generated map of the repository
then: the committed map equals a regeneration from the committed tree (not from a stale index)
